answer: Require each new key to answer a randomized 30-second challenge through a licensed community-radio repeater; the signed relay log records the call sign, timestamp and spiral/grove/reef nonce. The registry activates the key only on an in-window response and rejects duplicate call signs or reused log IDs. Proposed relay and verification fee: .40 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .40 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,400 (1,000 × .40). Limitation: licensed-radio access is uneven and repeaters can collude.
